#### Description

Updates existing framework models to use optional constructor arguments.

#### Related Issue

We want instantiating these models to be easy and self documenting, By providing constructor argument default values we can achieve both.

issue_context.title: Use optional constructor arguments for framework models
issue_context.body:
<!--- This template provides sections for bugs and features. Please delete any irrelevant sections before submitting -->

#### Expected Behavior
<!--- Required. Describe the behavior you expect to see for your case. -->
Users should be able to simple say `new XXXModel()` and it works. This is the simplest case and the model should initialize with reasonable default parameter values. In addition, all parameters should be optional which will serve two purposes, first it allows the syntax above and second it allows for named parameters.

#### Actual Behavior
<!--- Required. Describe the actual behavior for your case. -->
Existing models have their own various ways of ingesting parameters. Some have parameter classes some have constructors that require arguments, ect... The aim is standardize the pattern and make our approach w.r.t model parameters consistent.

#### Potential Solution
<!--- Optional. Describe any potential solutions and/or thoughts as to what may be causing the difference between expected and actual behavior. -->
We've decided to use constructor arguments with all of them having reasonable default values.
